notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
This is just a small update that adds a feature that should've been implemented from the start.
It adds the ability to save an unfinished level and let you come back at a later time.

notes.title: Release
notes.content: It was no april fools joke,we actually did release the game, for some reason. It comes packed with 500 levels in different formats to beat.
